{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cydorrian driller tree''' was a large tree with leathery leaves and an extensive root system that was able to survive in the valleys of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] spliced the genes for their root system with the native [[Hubba gourd/Legends|Hubba gourd]] in hopes of creating a more effective water-gathering plant for the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].
